title: Webcam clip restyled into a cinematic intro (Kling 4 Edit)
prompt_text: Edit @Video1. Keep the [man]'s real face exactly as filmed: same face shape, same [dark brown] eyes, same [beard], same words, same mouth movement, same head motion, eye movement, framing and timing. Change his look to match @Image1: [remove the black cap and give him the short, clean haircut and real hairline from @Image1], dress him in the [cream cable-knit Aran sweater] from @Image1, and put him in the [Lake Tahoe house] from @Image1, [with the tall black steel windows, pine trees, the lake at golden hour, the stone fireplace with a fire and the warm lamp], softly out of focus behind him. @Image2 is the last frame of the previous shot in this same video: match it exactly for the room, the background layout, the light, the color temperature, the exposure, his hair and his [sweater], so the cut between the shots is invisible. His eyes stay a deep [dark brown]. Real, unretouched skin with visible pores, no smoothing, no text.
